entries.what: Sleeps in until 9 a.m., then drives her hatchback to Ruel Road for the first 10-hour swing of mandatory overtime, 1 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. Spends the evening in the cage clearing a pile of frozen handhelds.
entries.outcome: Survived the first long shift, home near midnight.

entries.what: Eats leftover rice bowl at her desk in the IT cage next to the outbound break room and tells Bao the new quota will spike scanner failures.
entries.outcome: Agrees to move training time around the longer shift.

entries.what: Morning at home with Iris leaving for work at 8; Noemi studies subnetting for an hour. At Ridgeline she trains Bao on trigger board swaps at 3 p.m.
Evening of many dead scanners and pickers falling behind rate; Carla calls her cell about three dead units on the outbound dock.
entries.outcome: Swaps out the scanners, but the night stays chaotic.

entries.what: Late morning she sketches a plain-language guide for night pickers on rebooting frozen handhelds and asks her assistant to help write it in plain English and Spanish.
entries.outcome: Gets a short draft to print for the break room.

entries.what: Swing shift: tapes printed reboot guides near the outbound break room and walks a few pickers through the steps. Candidate forum talk about warehouse growth buzzes in the break room.
entries.outcome: Pickers use the guide the same night; fewer cage tickets.

entries.what: Studies for the cert with the practice-test app before shift, missing a handful of port-number questions.
entries.outcome: Notes port numbers as the drill for the weekend.

entries.what: Trains Bao on scanner repairs 3-5 p.m., then works the rest of the 10-hour swing. Iris orders Thursday sushi, saved for her to eat after midnight.
entries.outcome: Bao handles a battery swap and a trigger board.

entries.what: Fills up at the Ruel Road station and grabs Taquería Colima for her Friday shift meal.
entries.outcome: Lunch dealt with, one less thing to plan.

entries.what: Heavy Friday swing with scanner RMAs piling up; she updates the RMA sheet after hours and logs desk tickets.
entries.outcome: Sheet is current but a dozen units still wait for the vendor.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the morning, then works her every-other-Saturday overtime shift at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Fresh air helped before the long day.

entries.what: On break she forwards Iris's suggested study calendar to her assistant and asks it to be tweaked around overtime days.
entries.outcome: Gets a revised calendar with short weeknight sessions and a Sunday block.

entries.what: Visits her parents' fourplex off Vinca Avenue, fixes the printer, and her brother Mateo asks for help building his first PC for his December birthday.
entries.outcome: Agrees to help with a parts list.

entries.what: Spends a quiet afternoon on subnetting drills with the study guide, then plays the co-op survival game with her squad as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Finishes a drill set and a game session before bed.
